verdict.rationale: Marqeta's marketing page mentions 'PCI widgets' (marqeta-docs-17) implying hosted components for PAN/CVV reveal, but there is no documentation explaining how these widgets keep the developer's integration out of SAQ D scope, no technical integration guide, and no detail on ephemeral-key reveal flows. Missing for 10: technical documentation of the PCI widget implementation, explicit PCI-scope/SAQ D reduction claims, ephemeral-key or tokenized reveal flow details, and independent/hands-on confirmation of scope reduction.
